reason: The peak positions strongly support the 8.99556 A cubic metric (or the indexed half-volume tetragonal setting), but the submitted exact structures are not sufficiently established. No comparable whole-pattern Rwp was supplied, and the trajectory performed only extracted-line/intensity fitting (about 6.2% integrated-intensity R), with systematic intensity discrepancies far above the profile noise. The inference of Z = 1 from intensity hierarchy is not valid under a free scale factor; lower-symmetry Z = 2 models in the cubic cell, equivalently a Z = 1 model in the indexed ~6.360 x 6.360 x 8.996 A tetragonal cell, remain scientifically motivated. Although the trace announced a switch to that tetragonal solution, it never instantiated or refined one, and it compared only a narrow set of imposed cubic templates and P-43m site assignments. Physical plausibility is also poor: the submitted Z = 1 cell has density only ~4.26 g/cm3 and leaves all Ag and three of four In with nearest Te distances near 3.68 A, while introducing 2.66 A Te-Te contacts. The two CIFs merely swap nearly isoscattering Ag/In over the same high-symmetry framework and therefore do not cover the unresolved Z, symmetry, coordinate, and ordering alternatives. A materially different lower-symmetry, normally coordinated model could plausibly improve both fit and chemistry, so another solution attempt is warranted.
